_what: Calendar-year TOTAL RETURNS taken directly from the issuer's SEC filings. Used as ground truth for series that benchmarks.json does not carry an annual row for. Not shipped to the browser.
_provenance: GLOBAL_EQUITY = Vanguard Total World Stock Index Fund ETF Shares (VT), series S000022482, share class C000065038.
2009-2013 from the XBRL risk/return instance of 485BPOS filed 2014-02-27, accession 0000932471-14-004982 (CIK 0000857489), rr:AnnualReturn2009..2013.
2014-2021 from the XBRL risk/return instance of 485BPOS filed 2022-02-25, accession 0001683863-22-001067 (CIK 0000857489), rr:AnnualReturn2014..2021.
The two filings agree on their overlapping years (2012: 17.33, 2013: 22.98), which is the cross-filing consistency check.

Basis: fund total return based on NAV. The monthly VT series is market-price total return; the same 2022 filing prices that difference at 1-6bp annualised (1yr 18.25 NAV vs 18.24 market, 5yr 14.45 vs 14.48, 10yr 12.14 vs 12.08).

Total-return confirmation: these are the prospectus 'Annual Total Returns' bar-chart values, which the Investment Company Act risk/return taxonomy defines as total return with distributions reinvested. Independently confirmed by reconciliation - twelve monthly returns compound onto them to within 33bp for every year 2010-2020.
